# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in EchoShell a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our Standards

### Positive Behavior

- Using welcoming and inclusive language
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints
- Gracefully accepting constructive criticism
- Focusing on what is best for the community
- Showing empathy towards others

### Unacceptable Behavior

- Trolling, insulting/derogatory comments, and personal attacks
- Public or private harassment
- Publishing others' private information without permission
- Using this software for malicious or illegal purposes
- Unauthorized penetration testing or attacks
- Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate

## Responsible Use Policy

EchoShell is designed for educational and authorized defensive security purposes only.

### Allowed:
- Educational learning and research
- Authorized security testing with permission
- Defensive security research
- Academic study

### Prohibited:
- Unauthorized access to systems
- Malicious attacks or spoofing
- Any illegal activities
- Circumventing security without authorization

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the project maintainers at the repository. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly.

Project maintainers have the right to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned with this Code of Conduct, or to ban temporarily or permanently any contributor for behaviors that they deem inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.
